entry_points.description: uv project and Python tooling configuration
entry_points.template:
[project]
name = "{project_name}"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Python machine-learning data pipeline"
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.11"
dependencies = []

[dependency-groups]
dev = ["pre-commit>=4", "pytest>=8", "ruff>=0.17"]
ml = ["numpy", "pandas", "scikit-learn"]

[tool.uv]
default-groups = ["dev"]
package = false

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]
pythonpath = ["."]
addopts = "-ra"

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
target-version = "py311"

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "I", "UP", "B"]

entry_points.description: Python, repository hygiene, and Markdown lint hooks
entry_points.template:
default_install_hook_types:
  - pre-commit
  - commit-msg

repos:
  - repo: https://github.com/pre-commit/pre-commit-hooks
    rev: v6.0.0
    hooks:
      - id: trailing-whitespace
      - id: end-of-file-fixer
      - id: check-yaml
      - id: check-json
      - id: check-toml
      - id: check-merge-conflict
      - id: check-added-large-files
        args: ["--maxkb=5000"]

  - repo: https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff-pre-commit
    rev: v0.17.3
    hooks:
      - id: ruff
        args: ["--no-fix"]
      - id: ruff-format
        args: ["--check"]

  - repo: https://github.com/DavidAnson/markdownlint-cli2
    rev: v0.24.0
    hooks:
      - id: markdownlint-cli2

  - repo: https://github.com/compilerla/conventional-pre-commit
    rev: v4.4.0
    hooks:
      - id: conventional-pre-commit
        stages: [commit-msg]
        args: [--strict, feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore, revert]

entry_points.description: Getting started and project workflow documentation
entry_points.template:
# {project_name}

Starter structure for a Python machine-learning data pipeline. The scaffold
provides engineering conventions; select the model, data source, evaluation
method, and deployment flow from the actual project requirements.

## Tooling

- uv manages the Python project, dependency groups, and lockfile.
- pytest runs tests; Ruff checks and formats Python.
- pre-commit runs repository hooks, including Markdown lint.

## Set up when ready

```bash
uv lock
uv sync
uv sync --group ml
uv run pytest
```

`uv lock` resolves and writes `uv.lock`; `uv sync` installs the selected
project dependencies. The scaffold does not run these commands or install
packages. Review and commit the lockfile before relying on locked CI runs.

See `CONTRIBUTING.md` for pull request and Conventional Commits rules. The
pre-commit config checks Python, repository hygiene, and Markdown; it also
validates commit messages after hook installation.

## Quality checks

```bash
uv run ruff check .
uv run ruff format --check .
uv run pre-commit install --install-hooks
uv run pre-commit run --all-files
```

Raw datasets and generated model artifacts are ignored by default. Confirm data
handling, privacy, and artifact retention rules before changing those ignores.

entry_points.description: Project-specific Python workflow and data handling instructions
entry_points.template:
# Project Instructions

## Commands

- Install the project environment only when authorized: `uv sync`.
- Add the optional machine-learning dependency group when needed: `uv sync --group ml`.
- Run tests: `uv run pytest`.
- Run static checks: `uv run ruff check .` and `uv run ruff format --check .`.
- Run repository hooks: `uv run pre-commit run --all-files`.

## Engineering rules

- Keep application code under `src/` and tests under `tests/`.
- Use deterministic seeds and holdout data for model evaluation where applicable.
- Do not commit raw datasets, credentials, or generated model artifacts by default.
- Declare dependency changes in `pyproject.toml`; regenerate and review `uv.lock`.
- Keep text files UTF-8 with LF endings.
- Report tests and checks that were actually run; do not infer success from configuration files.

entry_points.description: Contribution workflow and Conventional Commits standard
entry_points.template:
# Contributing

## Local checks

Use the commands in `README.md`. Install the repository hooks after the project
environment is set up:

```bash
uv run pre-commit install --install-hooks
uv run pre-commit run --all-files
```

The installed `pre-commit` hook checks changed files. The `commit-msg` hook
checks the commit subject before Git creates a commit.

## Commit messages

Use the Conventional Commits format:

```text
<type>(<optional scope>): <short description>
```

Allowed types are `feat`, `fix`, `docs`, `style`, `refactor`, `perf`, `test`,
`build`, `ci`, `chore`, and `revert`. Keep the subject concise and describe the
change, not the issue number alone. Use `!` after the type or scope for a
breaking change and explain the impact in the body or footer.

Examples:

- `feat(training): add baseline model evaluation`
- `fix(data): reject empty input batches`
- `docs: explain the uv setup workflow`
- `refactor(pipeline)!: rename the prediction output field`

## Pull requests

Use `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`. Include actual test and lint results,
and identify data, model, dependency, and reproducibility impacts. Do not claim
checks passed when they were not run.

smoke_tests.template:
from src.utils.data_check import validate_batch_size

def test_batch_size_power_of_two():
    assert validate_batch_size(32) is True
    assert validate_batch_size(33) is False

ci_workflow:
name: {project_name} CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  code-quality:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v10.3.3
        with:
          python-version-file: "pyproject.toml"
          enable-cache: true
      - run: uv sync --frozen --all-groups
      - run: uv run ruff check .
      - run: uv run ruff format --check .
      - run: uv run pre-commit run --all-files

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v10.3.3
        with:
          python-version-file: "pyproject.toml"
          enable-cache: true
      - run: uv sync --frozen --all-groups
      - run: uv run pytest

  summary:
    needs: [code-quality, test]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Write Workflow Summary
        run: |
          echo "### CI Quality Gate Summary" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| Job | Result |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| :--- | :--- |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| code-quality | ${{ needs.code-quality.result }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| test | ${{ needs.test.result }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
      - name: Enforce Overall Gate
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ needs.code-quality.result }}" != "success" || "${{ needs.test.result }}" != "success" ]]; then
            echo "One or more CI jobs failed."
            exit 1
          fi
